additional_info.subject: 0437669 - ID0437669-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002095]Comissioning issue CRM:00314000190
additional_info.body:
Good afternoon Chloe,
I am reaching out from the Expert Team in regards of ticket
ID0437669
for charger
uJ6070.
Let me answer to your queries point by point:
Charger offline on SCB
: the charger it is actually online on SCB. However, we are facing some bugs in the status reporting on SCB. The issue has already been escalated, and will be taken care of by SCB team. In the meanwhile, in case you see on SCB a charger reporting the status offline, I would suggest you to check the error flags and the logs. If you see the charger logging, and the error flags visible, it means the charger is online on SCB.
Charger offline on OCPP Backend:
I connected remotely to the charger via SSH, and in my eyes everything looks fine. I doublechecked the settings on SCB and on the Teltonika Router XF4, and everything looks fine to me. The charger has mobile connection.
From the logs, I can see that the BootNotification is rejected from Greenflux Backend:
Therefore, please check if the OCPP ID of the charger is correct, if the IP address of Greenflux is correct, and if the mobile provider is the correct one.
It looks to me that either the Backend is rejecting the charger, or some settings are not correct and the charger cannot reach the backend.
FW upgrade:
I rolled out the FW v7.0.5 to the charger. I will activate the update as soon as it will be available on SCB.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!​​​​​​​
With kind regards,

additional_info.body:
Good evening Chloe,
I am glad the issue in configuration was identified and solved.
I can see that the charger is correctly connected to the Greenflux backend now. Yesterday I also updated the charger to v7.0.5. As all issues are solved, I will proceed to close this ticket.
At last, I want to remind that at the moment we are facing a bug on SCB in regards of the reporting of status of SCB and OCPP connection.
This bug has already been escalated and will be fixed by SCB team as soon as possible. In the meanwhile, in order to verify the SCB online state, I recommend you please to check the logs ad the error flags. If logs and error flags are generated, the charger is online on SCB. For OCPP connection, please check from Backend side the connection status, until this bug is fixed.
